title: Schedule of Rent-Change, Transfer and Move-Out Terms — RV & Boat Storage
content:
Schedule B to the RV & Boat Storage rental terms states the periods that govern rent increases and notice to vacate, and the fees for changing spaces and for a cleanout at move-out.

**B-1. Periods (identical in every space class)**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Months after move-in during which rent is not increased | 12 |
| Fewest calendar days of written notice before a rent increase takes effect | 30 |
| Largest increase one rate notice may apply, as a percentage of current rent | 8% |
| Fewest calendar days between a notice to vacate and the vacate date | 10 |

**B-2. Fees by space class (USD)**

| Space class | Fee for moving to a different space | Cleanout fee when debris or property is left in the space at move-out |
|---|---|---|
| Open Compact Storage Space | 25.00 | 75.00 |
| Open Standard Storage Space | 25.00 | 75.00 |
| Open Large Storage Space | 25.00 | 100.00 |
| Covered Standard Storage Space | 25.00 | 100.00 |
| Covered Large Storage Space | 25.00 | 125.00 |
| Enclosed Storage Unit | 25.00 | 150.00 |

Remarks on Schedule B:

1. The 8% figure is a ceiling on a single notice, expressed as a percentage of the current rent. On a hypothetical current rent of 72.00, 8% is 5.76.
2. The 25.00 transfer fee is the same whichever class the renter moves from or to; the cleanout fee rises with the class, from 75.00 for the two smallest open classes to 150.00 for the Enclosed Storage Unit.
3. The 10-day figure counts calendar days, so weekends and holidays are counted like any other day.
